title: Toolchain: TypeScript repos lint and type-check with Oxlint on tsrs, switched after a parity run
proof: On a git clone of merrilin 3ce25f01 in /tmp (read-only, deleted after), 16 cores, load1 4.5 to 5.8, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 GOMAXPROCS=4, oxlint --threads 4, 3 runs each: old oxlint 1.89.0 + oxlint-tsgolint 7.0.2005 --type-aware --type-check 2.47-2.86s, 926-1048 MB max RSS; old tsc 7.0.2 --noEmit --checkers 4 over 8 tsconfig programs 3.44-4.02s, 750-824 MB; new oxlint 1.94.0 + tsrs 7.1.0-beta.tsrs2 --type-aware --type-check 0.88-1.06s, 460-486 MB; new tsrs --noEmit --fast --checkers 4 over 8 programs 0.84-0.92s, 232-234 MB. Clean commit: 0 diagnostics old and new. strace shows oxlint 1.94 executes node_modules/.bin/tsrs-lint, not tsgolint. Planted a TS2322 and a floating promise in packages/scene/src/merge.ts and a TS2322 in the oxlint-ignored convex/betterAuth/_generated/server.ts: old (OXLINT_TSGOLINT_PATH=tsgolint) and new lint runs both exit 1 with the same 2 problems (TS2322 at 797:14, no-floating-promises at 799:3), diff identical, and both miss the ignored file; tsc and tsrs --noEmit both exit 1 with the same 4 lines, diff identical, including the ignored file. title: wow follows the browser-ban risk review: the ban is on checks, product may run a headless browser under runtime, scheduled reds are owned, guards run in every loop, production and outside services are checked without a browser, and work ships in batches within a ship-path budget
proof: npm test: 42 pass, 0 fail at 12d7442; 49 pass, 0 fail after (5 new deps tests, 2 new wow self tests). Each new rule seen red with its logic removed, then green restored: dropping @cloudflare/@sparticuz from the list fails 1 test; runtime allowing nothing fails 4; ignoring dev vs product fails 1, and so does treating Cargo dev-dependencies as product; allowing test runners under runtime fails 1; no stale runtime check fails 2; a runtime entry without a reason passing fails 2; non-browsers under runtime fails 1; a runtime folder with no manifest fails 1. The existing test that a plain reason never allows browser automation passes throughout. node bin/wow-guard.mjs all on wow: exit 1 at 12d7442 (deps: dependencies.json is missing; dashes: set wow.dashes.roots), exit 0 after; wow-guard dag exit 0. test/wow.test.mjs runs both on wow itself: red with dependencies.json removed and red with an em dash planted in guards/, then green.
